_comment: Template for a per-release plan. Copy to scripts/prod/releases/<date>-<slug>.json, fill in the real values for the release you've reviewed, and pass its path to scripts/prod-release.sh. Every guarded script cross-checks reality against this file and refuses on any mismatch — this file IS the human approval record.

migration._comment: Omit this whole block (set to null) for a release with no new migration.
